paths.name: @chakra-ui/react
paths.message: Import Dialog or Drawer from ~/components/ui/dialog and ~/components/ui/drawer instead. Modal-style flows also use the Dialog wrapper (see AICreateModal, RunScenarioModal, etc.) -- there is no Modal wrapper. The wrappers force a transparent backdrop (no dark grey overlay), wire focus/scroll defaults, and add an inline error boundary. Raw Chakra primitives reintroduce the dark backdrop we explicitly do not want.
